The '''List of Continents''' is a local review index for the source-backed continent names in the Avant world.

== Source List ==

The extracted source list names seven continents:

* [[Alberion]]
* [[Azuragon]]
* [[Erythrea]]
* [[Khalari]]
* [[Mantara]]
* [[Valoria]]
* [[Viridia]]

== Porting Role ==

This page exists to keep continent names connected while the 1994-back lore port continues. It is not a final geographic atlas. Several continent pages are still bridge drafts, and the exact coastlines, neighboring waters, wraparound relationships, and full state rosters need final map review against the 2003 and 2022 references.
